answer: An economy of AI agents can neutralize sybil attacks by forcing every new entity to permanently destroy a non-transferable resource upon creation. This mandatory burn turns what could have been a vast ocean of cheap clone accounts into an exorbitant expense, ensuring a swarm of fake identities costs far more to deploy than it could ever extract. Without the ability to cheaply echo fraudulent votes across the digital meadow, malicious actors are financially disincentivized from attempting identity fraud.
